['Raiffeisen Waren-Zentrale Rhein-Main e.company_description: Raiffeisen Waren-Zentrale Rhein-Main eG is one of the oldest and largest agricultural traders in Germany, with activities also in neighboring countries. As a wholesaler, they play an important role in the agricultural value chain by offering a range of products, services, and expertise. The company is the third largest agricultural cooperative in Germany and has recently transitioned to a joint-stock company (AG). In the fiscal year 2022, the RWZ group significantly exceeded its business goals, achieving a primary price-related revenue growth of 37% to reach 3.0 billion euros.

['Envia Mitteldeutsche Energie AG '].company_description: Envia Mitteldeutsche Energie AG is the leading regional energy service provider in East Germany. The company supplies more than 1.3 million customers with electricity, gas, heat, and energy services. They are also involved in solar and wind energy projects, as well as the operation of solar power plants.
